class.name: TagData
class.brief_description: Resource representing a hierarchical [Gameplay Tag] node in the Gameplay Ability System.
class.description: [TagData] is a custom resource used to define, organise, and store metadata for individual Gameplay Tags within the Gameplay Ability System (GAS). Gameplay Tags are dot-separated identifiers (such as [code]Effect.Status.Stunned[/code] or [code]Ability.Skill.Fireball[/code]) used throughout the system to categorise entity states, query capabilities, trigger effects, and apply conditional requirements. [TagData] objects form a tree structure where parent tags contain nested child tags.

members.member: An array of child [TagData] resources nested directly beneath this tag node in the hierarchy.
The unique internal integer identifier assigned to this tag within the tag registry system.
The local segment name of this specific tag node (e.g., [code]"Stunned"[/code] in [code]State.Status.Stunned[/code]).
The full dot-separated hierarchical path string representing the complete tag (Ex. [code]"State.Status.Stunned"[/code]).
